highlights.title: Tactile Production Engineering
highlights.text: We do not write toy code. From internal event engines to campus navigation systems, every build solves verified student needs with production-grade craft.

highlights.title: Cross-Disciplinary Swarms
highlights.text: Engineers, UX designers, product thinkers, and QA strategists collaborate directly, mimicking high-growth Silicon Valley product studios.

highlights.title: Unmatched Event Atmosphere
highlights.text: Every semester we launch high-octane coding arenas, design clashes, and multi-club invitationals that pack campus halls.

why_lead: Whether you are writing your first line of Dart or optimizing GPU shaders, MAD provides the runway, the hardware, and the crew to ship world-class software.

why.title: Portfolio of Deployed Apps
why.text: Graduate with actual app links on Google Play, TestFlight and GitHub, not just tutorial certificates.

why.title: Production Tech Stacks
why.text: Master Flutter, Kotlin Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Firebase, Supabase, SQLite, and WebSockets.

why.title: Elite Engineering Culture
why.text: Learn strict PR code reviews, semantic commits, automated linting, and continuous integration.

why.title: Direct Industry Runway

cta_title: Ready to craft apps that matter?
cta_text: Join over 150 student builders, participate in our upcoming hackathons, and turn your wildest product ideas into installed APKs.

about.manifesto_quote: Software is no longer just logic on a server—it is the tactile surface through which billions of humans experience reality. We exist to master that surface.
about.who: MAD Club (Mobile App Development Club) is the premier student-led digital product studio and engineering community at New Horizon College of Engineering, Bengaluru. Established in 2023, we empower students to transform raw ideas into launch-ready iOS, Android, and cross-platform applications.
about.objective: Bridge the gap between academic computer science and modern software craftsmanship. We provide hands-on sandboxes, production mentors, and high-stakes arenas for mobile programming, design systems, and product thinking.
about.outcomes: Mastery of industry-standard toolchains (Flutter, Dart, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Figma, Git), verified open-source contributions, portfolio-ready product launches, and deep collaborative competence.

timeline.title: Genesis & Mindspark'23
timeline.desc: Founded with a mission to bring true mobile product craft to NHCE. Launched Mindspark'23 with 150+ participants across 3 competitive rounds.

timeline.title: InnoWave, TechSync & Connect'24
timeline.desc: Expanded into hackathons and multi-club invitationals. Engineered TechSync'24 with 4 tech societies and rolled out member-built beta apps.

timeline.title: Codathon & Systems Evolution
timeline.desc: Ran 8-hour continuous mobile coding marathons, launched the open-source component library, and initiated Appsylum preparations.

timeline.title: The Next Frontier
timeline.desc: Deploying on-device AI models, advanced physical computing interfaces, and expanding inter-college hackathon circuits.
